questions.stem: Why should all joints in a potometer be sealed with petroleum jelly?

options.text: To prevent air leaks that would make the results inaccurate
To provide nutrients to the plant shoot
To stop the plant from photosynthesising
To keep the water at a constant temperature

questions.explanation: All seals must be airtight to ensure that the only reason water moves through the apparatus is because of transpiration. Air leaks would allow water to enter or leave, giving inaccurate measurements.
